applicability: HTTP answers of GET /api/review/intent/summary served by the dashboard process.
conditions: The configured native summary port produces typed result bodies; the app-owned conditional cache may validate retained bytes without another response body.
Without the port the route answers 503 by name.
exclusions: The other reviewer routes (/api/review/intent, /entries, /source-content), which keep their own refusal statuses.
statement: GET /api/review/intent/summary returns body-bearing typed states counted, partial or unavailable with its refusal as HTTP 200; conditional revalidation may return an empty 304 with ETag for retained bytes, and a process composed without the port answers named 503.
